meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 DeepSpot-M 把 224x224 的 H&E 切片图块换算成空间基因表达值(log1p-CPM),可按 HGNC 基因符号查询约 1.9 万个蛋白编码基因,并按图块网格排布输出。
howto.when: 当你要从 H&E 图块拿到空间基因表达(224x224、约 20x),或想按基因符号查询而不是用固定 panel 时触发;整张切片需先用 histolab 切块再批量预测。

say.text: 换一个 embedding source 再跑同一批图块
say.note: 五个 source 各给一次基因身份视图

say.text: 把这批图块拼成图块×基因矩阵并附上坐标
say.note: 结果可直接放进 AnnData 做下游分析

howto.what_en: Claude uses DeepSpot-M to map a 224x224 H&E histology tile to spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM. You can query ~19k protein-coding genes by HGNC symbol, or run batched prediction across a whole slide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need spatial expression for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or run whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D expression for this 224x224 tile with DeepSpot-M
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values in the gene order you passed

say_en.text: Rerun the same tiles with a different embedding source
say_en.note: Each source gives a different view of gene identity

say_en.text: Assemble the batch output into a tiles-by-genes matrix with coordinates
say_en.note: Drops into AnnData for spatial analysis
